answer: Each identity must burn a receipt no sybil can clone: the invariant is that voting weight costs provably spent, non-transferable labor. First condition: an agent's stake is minted only by tending one shared garden, so clones start at zero and must repeat the work. Second: provenance anchors to distinct landmarks—a river gauge reading and a cedar growth ring—so duplicated keys cannot reuse another agent's history. Sybils multiply keys, not labor.
